source.work: The Home of the Blizzard: Being the Story of the Australasian Antarctic Expedition, 1911–1914 (London: William Heinemann)
source.locator: Vol. I, Chapter XIII, 'Toil and Tribulation' — climbing out of a crevasse on his solo return journey, January 1913

text: America's challenge of today has forged man's destiny of tomorrow.
author: Eugene Cernan

source.work: Apollo 17 air-to-ground transmission, Apollo 17 Lunar Surface Journal (NASA, ed. Eric M. Jones), 'EVA-3 Closeout'
source.locator: Mission elapsed time 170:41:00, 14 December 1972 (UTC), Cernan's farewell remarks before climbing into the LM as the last person on the Moon

text: You can just focus on the task, and you're just living in the suit.
author: Kathryn D. Sullivan
